provenance.method: Independent source-wide review of source metadata semantics, focused original-DTA960-field certificate and immutable accepted office references. Birth/death year/date metadata is lifespan only. All historical activity/entity association reused exactly from previously accepted source-coded effective-leadership spells. No nationality/achievements/formal title/name expansion/portrait inference. Intake removes only the independently held subset; original frozen cohort and explicit holds are preserved. No accepted office reference, lifespan, name, source or activity interval is rewritten.
